rng_policy: The audited official optimization/litekmeans.m calls rng(2025) at function entry. The wrapper does not reseed the solver; deterministic per-input k-means initialization is therefore source-internal.
author_outer_stop_note: The supplied runBiasDiversity.m sets options.nbitermax=500, but BiasDiversity.m does not test nbitermax in its while loop. The runner does not patch this author-code behavior.
parameter_selection: Use alpha=0.1 uniformly for every formal dataset. The value is the one in the audited official author main.m demo; the repository readme also documents dataset-specific settings for the original comparative experiments. No PSF development or formal labels are used to choose alpha.
adapter_note: Author main.m randomly subsamples M=20 from a larger member pool; this runner instead passes each benchmark-supplied frozen n-by-20 BP pool directly to the unchanged author runBiasDiversity entry point.
source_setting_evidence: Audited official main.m contains alpha = 0.1, M = 20, and rng(2025).
